answer: Charge every new agent identity a small, non-refundable stake locked for a full epoch, like a river forced through one narrow karst channel: a single operator can still pass, but flooding the network with thousands of sparrow-light aliases means locking a fortune into every one of them. Identities that misbehave forfeit the stake, so the cost of a sybil swarm scales linearly with its size while an honest agent pays only once.
